mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL growth > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ growth < -1% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO MoM growth < -1% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% over the previous month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST MoM growth > 5% does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% for more than 3 consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS < 0.5% for 3 months does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).
